description: This file defines a thread-safe JSON storage manager class 'JSONStorage' for loading, saving, appending, updating, and filtering JSON data stored in files within a specified directory.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: A thread-safe manager for JSON data persistence, supporting load, save, append, update, get by id, and filter operations on JSON files.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a given directory path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _get_file_path
methods.description: Constructs a full Path object for a given filename, ensuring it has a .json extension.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads data from a JSON file; returns an empty list if the file doesn't exist or on decode error.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a list of dictionaries to a JSON file with indentation and Unicode support.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new item with metadata to the JSON file.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item by ID with provided fields; returns True if successful.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a single item by its ID from the JSON data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters JSON data based on provided key-value pairs.
